Daily a guide to hand-off notes
You can use this page
Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk hand-off notes

This page helps travelers and staff keep pet hand-offs smooth, calm, and easy to follow. It is meant for trips where a companion animal needs a little extra care before boarding, during transfer, or on arrival. Keep the notes clear, brief, and practical so the next person on duty can pick up without confusion.

Start with the basics: the traveler name, the pet name if available, the crate or carrier used, and any care details that matter for the trip. If a traveler like Lucia Brown or Layla Wong is checking in with Maggie, note what the pet needs most, such as water, quiet space, or a slower pace through the terminal. Good hand-off notes should make it simple for the welcome team to support the journey without adding stress.

When you move a pet through the terminal, mention any special handling steps that were already agreed on and any service points the traveler will need next. <<FACT F016>> Keep the note focused on what the next team member needs to know, not on long background details.

If there is a stop in the pet lounge, include the update in the same style, with a short note about what the traveler should expect after arrival. <<FACT F022>> A calm hand-off works best when the note stays direct, so the next team can act quickly and kindly.

For pets that need extra review before release, record the location and any next-step instructions in plain language. <<FACT F026>> If anything changes, pass the update along right away so the rest of the trip stays on track.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk and we will guide you through the next step.
